La verifica in due passaggi chiede, oltr: Two-step verification asks, on top of your password, for a second proof that it’s you: a code or a confirmation on your phone.
Chi ha rubato la password resta fuori se: Whoever stole your password stays locked out unless they also have your phone.
I codici non si danno a nessuno: chi te: Never give codes to anyone: whoever asks for them, even using a friend’s name, is trying to get into your account.
Fattori: qualcosa che sai (password), ch: Factors: something you know (password), something you have (phone, security key), something you are (biometrics). Authenticator apps generate TOTP codes (RFC 6238) from a shared secret and the time.
Gli SMS restano esposti al phishing in t: SMS codes remain exposed to real-time phishing and number theft; FIDO passkeys resist phishing because they are bound to the site.
